snippet.title: Adopted, Mercies (cover) Confluence Worship & Matt Redman
snippet.description:
Here is our cover medley of "Adopted" by Confluence Worship and "Mercies" by Matt Redman. This song was recorded live as a part of our online service on July 31, 2020.

To view the entire service, check out our "Online Services" playlist.

Need prayer? We'd love to connect! Just text "PRAY" to (314) 926-1800 and we'll connect you with someone who can pray with you.
